description: Create Spaces in two profiles from the sidebar, give them icons and themes, switch between them, fold Pins under the Space header, and verify persistence and teardown.
preconditions: Build and launch the exact Helium Dev.app from the selected lane with the isolated space-profiles profile
Keep one browser window open with the vertical sidebar expanded
Create at least one Pin in the starting Space
steps: Click the + button in the sidebar's bottom Space bar
Click the dashed icon slot, type house in the search field, and choose the house icon
Type Personal as the name, leave the profile on the current profile, pick the Orange swatch for the selected glow, raise Grain, set Browser to Dark, then click Create Space
Click + again, choose an emoji by typing it into the icon search field, name the Space Work, choose New profile, pick the Blue swatch, set Grain to zero, and click Create Space
Click the Personal icon in the bottom bar, then the Work icon, then the Personal icon again
Right-click the Work icon, choose Edit Space, change the icon to briefcase, and click Save
In a Space with Pins, click the Space name above the Pins, then click it again
Resize the sidebar, then switch Spaces; move the window, then switch again
In Personal, open Edit Space, set Pages to Light with Browser Dark, save, and load a page that honors prefers-color-scheme
Collapse the sidebar to the icon rail, click another Space's icon in the rail, then expand the sidebar
Create a Space named Scratch with one Pin, right-click it, choose Delete Space…, click Keep Space, then choose Delete Space… again and confirm
Open Edit Space for the current window's Space in a profile with other Spaces, click Delete Space… and confirm
Create a Space in a new profile, then delete it and confirm the profile deletion

Quit Helium Dev normally with both Personal and Work profiles present, relaunch the same isolated profile without a profile-directory flag, and inspect the bottom bar, Space themes, and the Pins header
Close every browser window without quitting, click the isolated Dev app in the Dock, and switch from Personal to Work using the Space bar
Stop the isolated profile after the restored state has been checked
observables: The + button replaces the tab list with the Create a Space form; Cancel or Escape restores the tab list and the window's own theme
The icon picker filters as you type, offers a typed emoji as the first choice, and supports arrow keys and Enter
Choosing a swatch or mode previews it on the current window before Create Space
Creating Personal opens its window at the same frame; the bottom bar lists one icon per Space and highlights the window's Space
Creating Work in a new profile creates that profile without an extra empty Space and opens Work at the same frame with a green theme
Switching Spaces raises the target Space's window at the current window's frame; its Favorites and sign-ins come from its own profile
Hovering a Space icon shows its name, plus its profile name when Spaces span profiles
Clicking the Space name hides the Pins and shows a right-pointing chevron; clicking again shows the Pins
The compact sidebar hides the Space header and shows only the current Space's icon in the bottom bar
After normal quit and relaunch, every Space keeps its icon, theme, profile, and folded Pins state, and the bottom bar lists Spaces from both profiles

Normal startup and Dock reopen go directly to a browser window without a profile selector, even when Chromium's legacy ask-on-startup preference is enabled; switching Spaces still selects the correct profile
Stopping the profile leaves no matching Helium Dev process and no newly timestamped crash report
The Theme card's preview shows the window background's glows; clicking adds a glow, dragging or arrow keys move it, Delete removes it, and the header + adds one by keyboard up to four
Glow color, intensity, and grain preview live on the window background, using the same effect as Settings > Appearance, so Personal and Work look clearly different
Browser and Pages modes apply separately: dark chrome with a light page, and the reverse
Switching or creating a Space carries the window frame, sidebar width, and collapsed state; windows still stacked at the previous frame follow, windows the user placed elsewhere keep their frames
The collapsed rail stacks every Space icon and switches on click; overflowing Spaces scroll, and the selected Space stays in view
Opening the form from the rail expands the sidebar and returns to the rail on Save or Cancel
The icon picker exposes named list box options for the visible rows and stays readable while scrolling
Delete Space confirms inline and says what goes; Keep Space and Escape delete nothing
A deleted Space leaves the bar, its Pins are gone after relaunch, and its windows close with their tabs
Deleting the current window's Space opens the neighbouring Space at the same frame first
Deleting a profile's only Space deletes that profile; the last Space anywhere cannot be deleted
